transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've been having pain in my left flank. It's been going on for the last four or five days now, and it's making me feel quite unwell.

Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have started recently, including the dose if you know it, and any allergies or bad reactions you’ve had to medicines—or if you don’t have any?
I don't take any regular medicines, and I haven't started anything new recently. I don't have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines that I know of.
Could you tell me a bit about your health in general—any ongoing conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays—and anything else you’ve noticed along with the flank pain?

The main thing is that another doctor told me I have a stone of about 1.3 cm in my left ureter. Along with the flank pain, I've had nausea and vomiting. The pain is in my abdomen and across my back too.
Is there anything that seems to make your pain better or worse?
I haven't really noticed anything that makes it better or worse. It just seems to be there most of the time.
Is there anything else you’d like to add about medicines—anything regular or anything you’ve taken recently?
No, nothing else. I don't take any regular medicines and haven't taken anything recently.
What’s on your mind most about what’s been going on, and what are you hoping we can do for you today?
What's on my mind most is that stone in my left ureter. I'd really like something done about it.
Could you tell me how bad the pain is for you, and how it’s affecting your daily life?
The pain is quite bad, and being sick with the nausea and vomiting makes it hard to get on with my usual day. I can't really say a number for it, but it's enough to keep me from doing much.
Can you tell me what the pain in your left flank feels like?
I'm not sure how to describe it really—it's just a pain in my left flank that also goes across my back. It's there most of the time rather than coming and going.
Besides the stone the other doctor told you about, is there anything else from your past health you’d like to add?
No, nothing else besides that stone. That's really the only thing I've been told about.
Besides the pain in your left side and the nausea and vomiting, is there anything else you’d like to tell me about?
No, that's about it. I should say there's no blood in my urine and no pain or burning when I pass urine, and no fevers.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how bad is the pain in your left side and back?
I'm sorry, I really can't put a number on it. It's bad enough that with the nausea and vomiting I'm not able to do much of anything.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
